summary: fix(settings): accept empty email query param on Index
description:
Because:

- An empty ?email= on the Index page failed IndexQueryParams validation and reported to Sentry.
- Malformed-email reports could not be split by relying party.

This commit:

- Validates email with IsEmailOrEmpty, matching loginHint.
- Makes the IsEmailOrEmpty message name the failing property.
- Adds a clientId tag to the Index container Sentry report.
- Adds unit tests for the empty and malformed cases.

Closes FXA-14836
